title: Peace comes by serving, not starring
summary: This meets the self that wants inner light without obedience. The line joins peace to serving the True Guru and recognizing the self honestly.
takeaway: Serve until the self stops starring.
lifeApplication: Before explaining yourself again, do the next act of obedience quietly. Let service bring light where self-display keeps asking for it.

source.shortMeaning: Serving the Guru brings peace and exposes the self to light.
source.lifeApplication: When ego reaches for the lead, answer first with service.

evidence.coreClaim: Serving the Guru brings peace and exposes the self to light.
evidence.turn: Serve first, and let peace expose the self.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before explaining yourself again, do the next act of obedience quietly. Let service bring light where self-display keeps asking for it.
